subject: Next steps: procurement path & timeline (paper PO vs marketplace)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps: procurement path & timeline (paper PO vs marketplace)

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the procurement path for the integration pilot:

Summary of call:
- Goal: 6-week pilot for Redwood inference powering clinical notes summarization across 3 clinics.
- Primary procurement options discussed: corporate PO (paper process), corporate card, or AWS Marketplace listing.
- Key internal reviewers: Legal (Tina), Security (infosec team / SOC2 artifacts), Finance (billing & PO issuance).

Proposed mutual action plan and timeline (draft):
1) This week: Acme confirms target procurement instrument (PO vs card vs marketplace).
2) Week of Jan 18: Redwood sends redwood_mpa_v1.pdf and procurement checklist (attached).
3) Jan 20–27: Security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence review.
4) Jan 28–Feb 4: Legal review and SOW/MPA redlines.
5) Feb 7–11: Finance finalizes PO issuance / billing setup.

Asks for Acme (can you confirm by EOD Fri?):
- Preferred payment instrument (PO / card / marketplace).
- Primary procurement contact + procurement email for paperwork.
- Any timing constraints for billing cutover (e.g., month-end PO requirement).

Attachments: redwood_mpa_v1.pdf (MPA draft), acme-procurement-checklist.xlsx (procurement readiness checklist).

If it helps, Ben can run a brief session with your procurement and finance people to walk the checklist — 20–30 minutes.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
This message contains Redwood Inference introductory materials. For security artifacts or compliance documents we will share specific links and access controls once we have the procurement contact and NDA in place.

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path & timeline (paper PO vs marketplace)

Thanks, Olga — appreciated the clear recap. A few quick answers and questions from our side:

Answers:
- We prefer to go the PO route (paper/official PO). Card is possible for small pilots but our procurement policy favors PO for any pilot > $10k.
- Procurement contact is procurement@acmehealth.com (cc'd).
- Timing: finance runs monthly cycles and ideally we'd have PO issued before Feb 1 to hit your pilot start window.

Questions:
- Do you need a signed NDA before we exchange SOC2 artifacts? We can do a quick mutual NDA if required.
- Can you confirm whether the MPA supports a short-term pilot SOW (30–60 days) without committing to enterprise terms?

I'll loop Procurement and Finance as needed.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Clinical Ops | Acme Health
sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com
(212) 555-0987

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Re: Next steps: procurement path & timeline (paper PO vs marketplace)

Olga / Lauren — forwarding Sarah's note. Quick notes on our side for the PO path:

- Legal: MPA can accommodate a pilot SOW appendix; we should prepare a 1–2 page SOW that limits scope and term. I will draft a pilot addendum and send by Jan 15.
- Security: we can share our SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA. If Acme prefers, we can also provide a short control summary and an onboarding checklist.
- Finance: PO issuance typically takes 5–7 business days once SOW + invoice are issued. To hit Feb 1 start, we need signed SOW and invoice by Jan 25.

Suggested next step: schedule a 30-min procurement walk-through with Sarah + procurement@acmehealth.com next Wed (Jan 20) — Ben to lead and go through the attached checklist.

I'll prepare the SOW draft and the invoice template.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: procurement@acmehealth.com <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Next steps: procurement path & timeline (paper PO vs marketplace)

Hi Olga / Ben — procurement team here. Quick confirmation and one ask:

1) We confirm PO route is preferred. Please send the following by Jan 21 so we can route through legal and finance:
   - Final SOW (signed by both parties) or draft SOW plus MPA reference.
   - Preliminary invoice referencing the SOW and line items.
   - SOC2 Type II (or signed NDA to access).

2) We can complete legal review within 5 business days of receiving the SOW/MPA redlines. Finance will require the invoice to generate the PO.

3) Marketplace is fine to discuss later but our procurement must approve Marketplace vendors case-by-case; given time constraints PO is the fastest.

Please cc procurement@acmehealth.com on any formal attachments. We will schedule an intake meeting once we receive the materials.

Thanks,
Acme Health Procurement
procurement@acmehealth.com

--
Forwarding instructions: send attachments as PDF where possible. If SOC2 cannot be attached, provide a secure link and ensure it's accessible only to acmehealth@redwoodinference-approved addresses.
